verdict.rationale: Khoj is a self-hostable and cloud AI assistant service, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions issuing API keys or tokens, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones. Login via Magic Links or Google OAuth and setting third-party model-provider keys (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY) are adjacent features and do not deliver agent-scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
